nodes.label: Remix App Core
nodes.description: Merchant-facing admin application built on Remix and Polaris, handling offer management, settings, and analytics.

nodes.label: Database & Persistence
nodes.description: PostgreSQL database managed with Prisma ORM storing sessions, offers, and analytics metrics.

nodes.label: Theme App Extension
nodes.description: Storefront UI blocks (Liquid & JS) injecting widgets for Volume, BOGO, Paired, and Selected offers on PDPs.

nodes.label: Shopify Functions
nodes.description: Sandboxed WASM runtime functions applying cart line discounts and delivery options directly at checkout.

nodes.label: shopify.server.js
nodes.description: Configures Shopify App API credentials, Prisma session storage, webhooks, and billing settings.

nodes.label: db.server.js
nodes.description: Prisma client singleton export for database queries.

nodes.label: schema.prisma
nodes.description: Prisma schema defining Session, Offer, and related data models.

nodes.label: volumeMetafields.server.js
nodes.description: Shards volume discount tiers into ~270B payloads stored on product.metafields.stack_up.volume_tiers.

nodes.label: bogoMetafields.server.js
nodes.description: Shards BOGO discount rules into compact product-level metafields.

nodes.label: bundleMetafields.server.js
nodes.description: Serializes paired / bundle product discounts onto individual product metafields.

nodes.label: selectedOffersMetafields.server.js
nodes.description: Serializes selected / add-on offer definitions onto targeted product metafields.

nodes.label: productConflicts.server.js
nodes.description: Validates that products are not assigned to conflicting offer types before creation or update.

nodes.label: app.offers._index.jsx
nodes.description: Dashboard listing active, scheduled, and draft discount offers with status toggles and delete actions.

nodes.label: app.offers.volume.create.jsx
nodes.description: Offer creation wizard for Volume/Tiered discounts with product picker and tier builder.

nodes.label: app.offers.bogo.create.jsx
nodes.description: Offer creation wizard for Buy One Get One (BOGO) campaigns.

nodes.label: app.offers.paired.create.jsx
nodes.description: Offer creation wizard for Frequently Bought Together / Paired discounts.

nodes.label: app.offers.selected.create.jsx
nodes.description: Offer creation wizard for Selected Products & Cross-sell Add-on campaigns.

nodes.label: webhooks.orders.create.jsx
nodes.description: Captures completed orders, verifies StackUp discount codes, and increments usage counts and attributed revenue.

nodes.label: volume-discount (WASM)
nodes.description: Shopify Function evaluating cart line quantities against product.metafields.stack_up.volume_tiers.

nodes.label: bogo-discount (WASM)
nodes.description: Shopify Function evaluating BOGO pairs and applying percentage or fixed discounts to line items.

nodes.label: paired-products-discount (WASM)
nodes.description: Shopify Function verifying bundle co-presence in cart and distributing package discounts.

nodes.label: selected-products-discount (WASM)
nodes.description: Shopify Function evaluating cross-sell add-on products and discounting qualifying lines.

nodes.label: volume-discount.liquid
nodes.description: Liquid block rendering quantity tier options directly on the Product Detail Page.

nodes.label: bogo-widget.liquid
nodes.description: Liquid block presenting BOGO options with automatic cart addition.

nodes.label: stack-up.js
nodes.description: Storefront client script handling variant switching, AJAX cart updates, and tier selection state.
